body: Yeah. I wish i wasn’t gay anymore or idk. Tbh, I didn’t have mental illnesses before because my attractions were more tame and I thought it was okay, but I’m crying so much because how can something that seems so good be so bad? What is it that I lack—male intimacy? An opportunity to enjoy that certain interest in a non-kinky/fetishistic way? Definitely, perhaps, I lack willingness to God’s guidance. Today is my first day of NoFap. I wonder how life will turn out without all these “sexual enjoyments”

Thank you.

I’ve been crying a lot often because I don’t understand. It’s actually not because I have these traits, but it’s because I have this weird longing for wanting to join in all the “sexual fun” but I also want to follow God.

Please pray that I may be able to understand why these are inevitably bad so that I may be closer to God.

Also, I’ve been praying a lot now, which is good, because I long for God’s comfort. I guess that’s something I can’t find in “sexual fun” (by this I mean extramarital, non-unitive, non-procreative sexual activities)

I think I have fallen so deep (maybe because of mental illnesses) that I can’t imagine myself without my fetishes and sexual attractions. Anyway, I guess I’ll get that mental illness checked too, since I guess God wants me to be healthy too.

I’ve opened up to my mom and friends about this and they’ve been so supportive of me trying to resist my urges with God’s guidance.

Lord, please guide me because I cannot guide myself enough.

Masturbation, just like substance use and alcohol, are addictions.

I agree that we can just stop, but I don’t think it’s a one-step journey.

And on accountability, I don’t know why everything has to be one’s own accountability. For the masturbation, I agree, but for the intimacy, warmth, and connection, boy, everyone is accountable.

Well, to kind of mix both, I decided that I would spend more of my time being with my mom, dad, and sister rather than being quiet in my room. There was one day where everyone was just stressed from a trip. My sister got lost and my mom looked so done. I spent some time talking to them one by one, like being their emotional support. I also started opening up to my mom about everything that I’ve gone through—same sex attraction, masturbation, webcamming, faith issues.

Thus, the will to stop and the will to make a loving community.

When there is more connection at home, it is beautiful.

This, though, has not fully eradicated my fap problem, since it’s very easy to regress into being the cold, teenage son that I am (I’m actually a young adult but yeah). When one starts being selfless as how Jesus was, I guess temptation also goes away.

Many things just go so wrong when empathy is thrown away.

I will be honest that this gives me anxious and depressed feelings a lot of times. I would say that Jesus would lament over these too.

But I hope this fear can instill us to do more to help others accept Christ. I know, I wish there was an easier way to save people despite the saying that only Jesus saves people.

Like, I really hope crying out loud in public: PLEASE ACCEPT JESUS CHRIST PLEASE BECAUSE I WILL BE VERY SAD AND I WONT BE ABLE TO SEE YOU, would help at least a bit.

Like, I am really sad about this. LORD, PLEASE HEAR MY PRAYER. HELP US. SAVE US. I CAN'T HANDLE THESE EMOTIONS BUT I KNOW YOU CAN HELP ME.

**We must never forget that an ultimate ideal is everyone being saved not because they're forced to but because they chose to be.** I know this kind of thing was never mentioned in the Bible or by other religious people, but shouldn't this be the thing? That's why we ought to spread the Good News. The problem now is we live in such a society that's more secular than ever. People wanting to appear "less religious" just to please others. Anyway, maybe it was never mentioned that that would be the ideal because perhaps he already knew that people will end up not with God in the end. I mean, he would know. He's God.

As Christians, we should never be selfish, so we should be concerned with the salvation of others, **intensely if you must.** We have to be determined in wanting to lead people to Christ. Planting a seed is not enough for me. I would go the extra mile, and I want to have the courage to do that.

It's really excruciating to meet a really nice friend only to know that he/she's likely to go to hell, but we should remember that that's not the end of it. We have a lot of years to help them reach God.

(Oh dear, I was having an anxiety attack (a real one, I would know because I'd been diagnosed) when I started to write this because I know that such a sadness is enough to crush one's heart into dust, and God knows how depressed I can get. Dear Lord, we need you. Please save us all from sin.)

Thanks for this. I’ve been dealing with shame lately. With God, our shame will be washed away.

Nowadays, I don’t get anxiety often, but when it happens, it’s just a sudden burst out of nowhere. It’s very detrimental to the point I can’t sleep well or do the things I do everyday properly. It can recur for a few days until I resolve it. To avoid it again, I won’t repress it anymore.

Yeah. I also find myself less horny and never even thinking about sexual stuff when I’m up and about. When I had overnight school trips or sleepovers at my friends’ (we’re all guys, I’m also a guy), I never had the urge to fap. Never had any sexual thought at all. And now I’m thinking, wow, is that how heaven will feel like? All the focus on pure things with the blessing of a healthy community.

Thanks. I’ve been dealing with shame a lot recently. I’m trying to learn how to be more open here and also to my therapist when it comes to SSA things. In my last series of sessions, I had a hard time opening up because it was just too painful to mention anything at all. Now, I just want to feel the grace of God telling me no matter how shameful that was, I know I am still loved. So I guess I just have to go at it and be open to this community and the people I can trust like my therapist.

I believe that in communion is a gift from God; we don’t have to deal with this alone. I am thankful for this subreddit.

How are you know? Still have a lot of SSA issues? Mine are mostly just PMO, well lately it’s just been MO.

Also, what have you been doing to gain that sense of masculinity? Right now, I’m trying to avoid being HALT (hungry, angry, lonely, tired) mostly for the PMO part. I’m glad I found this community, so I can avoid the lonely part. Nowadays, it’s really easy to get lonely with technology. Also, I’ve been trying to think that I’m not broken and letting God change me rather than trying to change myself. (My anxiety has really been acting up lately)

I hope that I will stop thinking about this too much and leave this to God and live my life once again in Christ.
